Chair Senator Maria Cantwell (D-Wash.) and Ranking Member Senator Ted Cruz (R-Texas) announced that the Senate Commerce, Science and Transportation Committee will convene an Executive Session to consider the Senate Bipartisan Federal Aviation Administration Reauthorization Act of 2023 on Thursday, February 8, 2024, at 10:00 a.m. EST.

Read today’s press release on the legislation here.
